events.title: A Look At Banco Santander (BME:SAN) Valuation After Q1 Results And UK Branch And TSB Reshaping
events.body: Banco Santander (BME:SAN) has drawn fresh attention after reporting first quarter 2026 results, with higher net interest income and net income. The bank is also reshaping its UK footprint through branch closures and the integration of TSB.

events.title: Santander to drop UK’s TSB name after takeover
events.body: The Spanish lender intends to operate the enlarged business under the Santander UK name once the integration of the two banks has been completed.

events.title: European banks show mixed results as HSBC profits dip while UniCredit's rise
events.body: HSBC reported a slight contraction in profits while Italy's UniCredit surpassed market expectations as banking institutions navigate a complex landscape defined by geopolitical tensions.View on euronews
